40020601.author: पदार्थः
40020601.content: अथ thereafter, जित्वा having conquered, मरुत्तं Marutta, सः he, प्रययौ went forth, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rākṣasas, नगराणि to the cities, नरेन्द्राणां of kings, युद्धकाङ्क्षी desirous of battle, दशाननः Daśānana.

40020601.author: Translation
40020601.content: After conquering Marutta, Daśānana, the lord of Rākṣasas, being desirous of battle, then proceeded to the cities of other kings.

40020602.author: पदार्थः
40020602.content: समासाद्य having approached, तु indeed, राजेन्द्रान् the great kings, महेन्द्रवरुणोपमान् comparable to Mahendra and Varuṇa, अब्रवीत् said, राक्षससेन्द्रस्तु but the lord of Rākṣasas, युद्धं battle, मे to me, दीयताम् let it be given, इति thus.

40020602.author: Translation
40020602.content: Having approached those great kings who were comparable to Mahendra and Varuṇa, the lord of Rākṣasas then demanded, "Let battle be given to me."

40020603.author: पदार्थः
40020603.content: निर्जिताः we are conquered, स्म are, इति thus, वा or, ब्रूत say, एषः this, मे my, हि indeed, सुनिश्चयः firm resolve, अन्यथा otherwise, कुर्वताम् for those acting, एवं thus, मोक्षः liberation, न not, एव indeed, उपपद्यते is possible.

40020603.author: Translation
40020603.content: He declared, "Either say 'we are conquered,' for this is my firm resolve; otherwise, for those who act differently, there is no escape."

40020604.author: पदार्थः
40020604.content: ततः then, तु indeed, अभीरवः fearless, प्राज्ञाः wise, पार्थिवाः kings, धर्मनिश्चयाः firm in righteousness, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, ततः then, अन्योन्यं among themselves, राजानः the kings, सुमहाबलाः exceedingly powerful, निर्जिताः we are conquered, स्म are, इति thus, अभाषन्त they said, ज्ञात्वा having known, वरबलं the strength of the boon, रिपोः of the enemy.

40020604.author: Translation
40020604.content: Then, those fearless, wise, and righteous kings, though exceedingly powerful, consulted among themselves and, recognizing the enemy's strength derived from boons, declared, "We are conquered."

40020605.author: पदार्थः
40020605.content: दुष्यन्तः Dushyanta, सुरथो Suratha, गाधिर् Gadhi, गयो Gaya, राजा king, पुरूरवाः Pururava, एते these, सर्वे all, अब्रुवंस् said, तात O dear one, निर्जिताः conquered, स्म are, इति thus, पार्थिवाः kings.

40020605.author: Translation
40020605.content: Kings like Dushyanta, Suratha, Gadhi, Gaya, and Pururava all declared themselves conquered, saying, "O dear one, we are vanquished."

40020606.author: पदार्थः
40020606.content: अथ then, अयोध्यां Ayodhya, समासाद्य having reached, रावणो Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः lord of Rakshasas.

40020606.author: Translation
40020606.content: Then, Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, having reached Ayodhya...

40020607.author: पदार्थः
40020607.content: सुगुप्ताम् well-protected, अनरण्येन by Anaranya, शक्रेण by Indra, इव as if, अमरावतीम् Amaravati, स he, तं that, पुरुषशार्दूलं tiger among men, पुरन्दरसमं equal to Indra, बले in strength.

40020607.author: Translation
40020607.content: ...(Ravana reached Ayodhya) which was well-protected by Anaranya, just as Amaravati is protected by Indra; he (Ravana) then approached that tiger among men, Anaranya, who was equal to Indra in strength.

40020608.author: पदार्थः
40020608.content: प्राह said, राजानम् to the king, आसाद्य having approached, युद्धं battle, देहि give, इति thus, रावणः Ravana, निर्जितो conquered, अस्मि I am, इति thus, वा or, ब्रूहि say, त्वम् you, एवम् thus, मम my, शासनम् command.

40020608.author: Translation
40020608.content: Having approached the king, Ravana said, "Give me battle, or else declare 'I am conquered' – this is my command to you."

40020609.author: पदार्थः
40020609.content: अयोध्याधिपतिस् the lord of Ayodhya, तस्य his, श्रुत्वा having heard, पापात्मनः of the evil-minded one, वचः words, अनरण्यस् Anaranya, तु but, सङ्क्रुद्धो greatly enraged, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the lord of Rakshasas, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020609.author: Translation
40020609.content: Having heard the words of that evil-minded Ravana, Anaranya, the lord of Ayodhya, became greatly enraged and then spoke to the lord of Rakshasas.

40020610.author: पदार्थः
40020610.content: दीयते is offered, द्वन्द्वयुद्धं a duel, ते to you, राक्षसाधिपते O lord of Rākṣasas, मया by me, सन्तिष्ठ prepare yourself, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आयत्तः ready, भव be, च and, एवम् thus, भवामि I will be, अहम् I.

40020610.author: Translation
40020610.content: O lord of Rākṣasas, I offer you a duel; prepare yourself quickly, and I too shall be ready in the same manner.

40020611.author: पदार्थः
40020611.content: अथ then, पूर्वम् previously, श्रुतार्थेन by the heard prophecy, निर्जितं destined to be defeated, सुमहद्बलम् a very great army, निष्क्रामत् marched out, तत् that, नरेन्द्रस्य of the king, बलं army, रक्षोवधोद्यतम् intent on killing Rākṣasas.

40020611.author: Translation
40020611.content: Then, that very great army of the king, which was previously destined to be defeated by the heard prophecy and was intent on killing Rākṣasas, marched out.

40020612.author: पदार्थः
40020612.content: नागानां of elephants, दशसाहस्रं ten thousand, वाजिनां of horses, नियुतं a hundred thousand, तथा and, रथानां of chariots, बहुसाहस्रं many thousands, पत्तीनां of foot soldiers, च and, नरोत्तम O best among men.

40020612.author: Translation
40020612.content: O best among men, that army consisted of ten thousand elephants, a hundred thousand horses, many thousands of chariots, and foot soldiers.

40020613.author: पदार्थः
40020613.content: महीं the earth, सञ्छाद्य having covered, निष्क्रान्तं marched out, सपदातिरथं with foot soldiers and chariots, रणे for battle, ततः then, प्रवृत्तं commenced, सुमहत् a very great, युद्धं battle, युद्धविशारद O expert in warfare.

40020613.author: Translation
40020613.content: O expert in warfare, that army, covering the earth with its foot soldiers and chariots, marched out for battle, and then a very great battle commenced.

40020614.author: पदार्थः
40020614.content: तत् that, अद्भुतम् amazing (battle), अनरण्यस्य of Anaraṇya, नृपतेः of the king, च and, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of Rākṣasas, बलं the army, तस्य of that, महीपतेः king, रावणबलं Ravana's army, प्राप्य having encountered.

40020614.author: Translation
40020614.content: That amazing battle between King Anaraṇya and the lord of Rākṣasas commenced when the king's army encountered Ravana's army.

40020615.author: पदार्थः
40020615.content: प्राणश्यत perished, तदा then, सर्वम् all, हव्यम् oblation, हुतम् offered, इव like, अनले in fire, युद्ध्वा having fought, च and, सुचिरम् for a very long, कालम् time, कृत्वा having performed, विक्रमम् valor, उत्तमम् excellent.

40020615.author: Translation
40020615.content: Then, all (the army) perished like an oblation offered into fire, even after fighting for a very long time and displaying excellent valor.

40020616.author: पदार्थः
40020616.content: प्रज्वलन्तम् blazing, तम् him, आसाद्य having approached, क्षिप्रम् quickly, एव indeed, अवशेषितम् was left (destroyed), प्राविशत् entered, सङ्कुलम् the multitude, तत्र there, शलभाः moths, इव like, पावकम् fire, नश्यति perished, स्म (past tense), बलम् the army, तत्र there, हव्यम् oblation, हुतम् offered, इव like, अनले in fire.

40020616.author: Translation
40020616.content: Having approached that blazing (Anaranya), the multitude of soldiers quickly perished, entering him like moths into a fire; the army there was destroyed like an oblation offered into fire.

40020617.author: पदार्थः
40020617.content: सः he, अपश्यत् saw, तत् that, नरेन्द्रः king, तु indeed, नश्यमानम् perishing, महाबलम् great army, महार्णवम् great ocean, समासाद्य having reached, वनापगशतम् hundreds of forest rivers, यथा just as.

40020617.author: Translation
40020617.content: That king (Anaranya) indeed saw his great army perishing, just as hundreds of forest rivers disappear upon reaching the great ocean.

40020618.author: पदार्थः
40020618.content: ततः then, शक्रधनुःप्रख्यम् resembling Indra's bow, धनुः his bow, विस्फारयन् stretching, स्वयम् himself, आससाद approached, नरेन्द्रः the king, तम् him, रावणम् Ravana, क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome with rage.

40020618.author: Translation
40020618.content: Then, the king (Anaranya), himself stretching his bow which resembled Indra's rainbow, approached Ravana, overcome with rage.

40020619.author: पदार्थः
40020619.content: अनरण्येन by Anaranya, ते those, अमात्याः ministers, मारीचशुकसारणाः Maricha, Shuka, Sarana, प्रहस्तसहिताः along with Prahasta, भग्नाः defeated, व्यद्रवन्त fled, मृगाः deer, इव like.

40020619.author: Translation
40020619.content: Those ministers of Ravana, namely Maricha, Shuka, Sarana, along with Prahasta, were defeated by Anaranya and fled like deer.

40020620.author: पदार्थः
40020620.content: ततः then, बाणशतानि hundreds of arrows, अष्टौ eight, पातयामास shot, मूर्धनि on the head, तस्य of that, राक्षसराजस्य of the king of Rakshasas, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः the delight of the Ikshvaku family.

40020620.author: Translation
40020620.content: Then, the delight of the Ikshvaku family (King Anaranya) shot eight hundred arrows onto the head of that king of Rakshasas (Ravana).

40020621.author: पदार्थः
40020621.content: तस्य his, बाणाः arrows, पतन्तः falling, ते those, चक्रिरे caused, न not, क्षतम् injury, क्वचित् anywhere, वारिधाराः streams of water, इव like, अभ्रेभ्यः from clouds, पतन्त्यः falling, गिरिमूर्धनि on the mountain peak.

40020621.author: Translation
40020621.content: Those falling arrows of his caused no injury anywhere, just like streams of water falling from clouds onto a mountain peak.

40020622.author: पदार्थः
40020622.content: ततः then, राक्षसराजेन by the king of Rakshasas, क्रुद्धेन enraged, नृपतिः the king, तदा then, तलेनाभिहतः struck with the palm of the hand, मूर्ध्नि on the head, सः he, रथात् from the chariot, निपपात fell down, ह indeed.

40020622.author: Translation
40020622.content: Then, the enraged king of Rakshasas struck the king on the head with his palm, and he indeed fell down from his chariot.

40020623.author: पदार्थः
40020623.content: सः that, राजा king, पतितः fallen, भूमौ on the ground, विह्वलाङ्गः with trembling limbs, प्रवेपितः greatly trembling, वज्रदग्धः struck by a thunderbolt, इव like, अरण्ये in the forest, सालः a Sala tree, निपतितः fallen, यथा just as.

40020623.author: Translation
40020623.content: That king, fallen on the ground with trembling and bewildered limbs, was greatly trembling, just like a Sala tree struck down by a thunderbolt in the forest.

40020624.author: पदार्थः
40020624.content: तम् to him, प्रहस्य laughing loudly, अब्रवीत् said, रक्षः the Rakshasa, इक्ष्वाकुम् to the Ikshvaku, पृथिवीपतिम् the king, किम् what, इदानीम् now, फलम् result, प्राप्तम् obtained, त्वया by you, माम् me, प्रति against, युद्ध्यता fighting.

40020624.author: Translation
40020624.content: Laughing loudly, the Rakshasa (Ravana) then said to that Ikshvaku king, "What result have you now obtained by fighting against me?"

40020625.author: पदार्थः
40020625.content: त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, न not, अस्ति there is, यः who, द्वन्द्वम् a challenge, मम to me, दद्यात् would give, नराधिप O king of men, शङ्के I suspect, प्रसक्तः attached, भोगेषु to pleasures, न not, शृणोषि you hear, बलम् strength, मम my.

40020625.author: Translation
40020625.content: O king of men, there is no one in the three worlds who can challenge me; I suspect you are too engrossed in pleasures to know my strength.

40020626.author: पदार्थः
40020626.content: तस्य to him, एवम् thus, ब्रुवतः speaking, राजा the king, मन्दासुः with failing life, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, किम् what, शक्यम् is possible, इह here, कर्तुम् to do, वै indeed, कालः time, हि for, दुरतिक्रमः difficult to overcome.

40020626.author: Translation
40020626.content: To him who spoke thus, the king, with his life ebbing away, replied, "What can be done now, for time is indeed insurmountable?"

40020627.author: पदार्थः
40020627.content: न not, हि indeed, अहम् I, निर्जितः conquered, रक्षः O demon, त्वया by you, च and, आत्मप्रशंसिना self-praising, कालेन by time, एव alone, विपन्नः destroyed, अहम् I, हेतुभूतः being the cause, तु but, मे my, भवान् you.

40020627.author: Translation
40020627.content: O self-praising demon, I am not conquered by you; I am destroyed by time itself, and you are merely the instrument of my demise.

40020628.author: पदार्थः
40020628.content: किम् what, तु but, इदानीम् now, मया by me, शक्यम् is possible, कर्तुम् to do, प्राणपरिक्षये at the exhaustion of life, न not, हि indeed, अहम् I, विमुखी turning away, रक्षः O demon, युध्यमानः fighting, त्वया by you, हतः killed.

40020628.author: Translation
40020628.content: What can I possibly do now, with my life force depleted? O demon, I was not killed by you while turning away, but while fighting.

40020629.author: पदार्थः
40020629.content: इक्ष्वाकुपरिभावित्वात् due to being born in the Ikshvaku lineage, वचः words, वक्ष्यामि I will speak, राक्षस O demon, यदि if, दत्तम् given (charity), यदि if, हुतम् offered (sacrifices), यदि if, मे my, सुकृतम् well-performed, तपः penance, यदि if, गुप्ताः protected, प्रजाः subjects, सम्यक् properly, तदा then, सत्यम् true, वचः words, अस्तु let it be, मे my.

40020629.author: Translation
40020629.content: O demon, by virtue of my birth in the Ikshvaku lineage, I will speak these words: if I have given charity, offered sacrifices, performed penance well, and protected my subjects properly, then let my words be true.

40020630.author: पदार्थः
40020630.content: उत्पत्स्यते will be born, कुले in the family, हि indeed, अस्मिन् in this, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled ones, रामः Rama, दाशरथिः son of Dasharatha, नाम named, यः who, ते your, प्राणान् lives, हरिष्यति will take away.

40020630.author: Translation
40020630.content: Indeed, in this family of the great-souled Ikshvakus, a son named Rama, the son of Dasharatha, will be born, who will take away your life.

40020631.author: पदार्थः
40020631.content: ततः then, जलधरोदग्र mighty as a cloud, ताडितः struck, देवदुन्दुभिः the divine drum, तस्मिन् when that, उदाहृते was uttered, शापे curse, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, च and, खात् from the sky, च्युता fell.

40020631.author: Translation
40020631.content: Then, as that curse was uttered, a divine drum, struck with a sound mighty as a cloud, resounded, and a shower of flowers fell from the sky.

40020632.author: पदार्थः
40020632.content: ततः then, सः that, राजा king, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, गतः went, स्थानम् to the abode, त्रिविष्टपम् of heaven, स्वर्गते having gone to heaven, च and, नृपे the king, तस्मिन् that, राक्षसः the demon, सः he, अपसर्पत departed.

40020632.author: Translation
40020632.content: Then, O king of kings, that king went to the abode of heaven, and when that king had ascended to heaven, the demon departed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनविंशः सर्गः ।। 19 ।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
